metrics.gotcha: isAdmin is BOOLEAN — Super Admin flag. isDelegatedAdmin (also boolean) covers delegated admin roles. Use isAdmin for Super Admin count.

metrics.name: Users Without 2-Step Verification Enforced Count
metrics.gotcha: isEnforcedIn2Sv (boolean) = admin policy enforces 2SV for this user. isEnrolledIn2Sv (boolean) = user has set up 2SV. A user can be enrolled but not enforced — use isEnforcedIn2Sv for compliance checking.

metrics.name: Users List
metrics.gotcha: Users[] confirmed fields: id, etag, kind, name (object with fullName), emails (array), isAdmin (boolean), archived (boolean), suspended (boolean), usageGB_r (string), primaryEmail (string), agreedToTerms (boolean), isEnforcedIn2Sv (boolean), isEnrolledIn2Sv (boolean), isDelegatedAdmin (boolean), lastLoginTime (string), creationTime (string).
